title: A2UI MCP Catalog
description: A2UI catalog for Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations. It defines `callMcpTool` and data functions that transform tool results into data model updates, and the `McpApp` component that renders a sandboxed MCP App connected to the host through the MCP Apps bridge.

McpApp.description: Renders a sandboxed Model Context Protocol application using double-iframe isolation. The application talks to the host over the MCP Apps JSON-RPC bridge; tool calls it is allowed to make are dispatched as A2UI actions. See mcp_app_specification.md for the protocol and the security controls.

htmlContent.description: The HTML content of the app, rendered via srcdoc inside the sandbox. A value prefixed with `url_encoded:` is decoded with decodeURIComponent before rendering.

title.description: The title of the app, used as the accessible title of the frame.

allowedTools.description: The names of the MCP tools the app is allowed to call. The host dispatches an authorized `tools/call` request as an A2UI action named after the tool, with the tool arguments as its context, and rejects any other tool call.

callMcpTool.description: Invokes a tool on a connected Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and returns the result. Can be combined with `jmespath` and `updateDataModel` to update the surface data model from tool output.

name.description: The name of the MCP tool to execute.

arguments.description: The arguments to pass to the MCP tool.

jmespath.description: Evaluates a JMESPath expression against input data.

expression.description: A standard JMESPath expression evaluated against `data`.

data.description: The input data to evaluate the expression against.

split.description: Splits a string or array of strings by a separator.

value.description: The string or array of strings to split.

separator.description: The delimiter string to split on. An empty string splits into individual characters.

regexCapture.description: Extracts capture groups from the first RE2 regular expression match.

value.description: The string or array of strings to match against.

pattern.description: An RE2 regular expression. Returns an array of capture groups from the first match, or null if there is no match. Unmatched optional groups return empty strings.

regexReplace.description: Replaces all matches of an RE2 regular expression with literal text.

value.description: The string or array of strings to perform replacements on.

pattern.description: An RE2 regular expression matching substrings to replace.

replacement.description: Literal replacement string. Capture group references like $1 are treated as literal text.

updateDataModel.description: Writes key-value pairs to the surface data model.

updates.description: An object mapping data model paths to the values to write (e.g., {"/entries": [...], "/title": "Home"}). Paths starting with "/" are absolute; relative paths resolve against the current data context.

JsonSchema.description: A JSON Schema. The host validates the matching payload against it before acting on the message; an empty object accepts any value.

AllowedFunctions.description: A map of authorized host client function names to JSON Schemas describing their expected arguments. The host rejects a `ui/requests/function-call` request whose function is not listed or whose arguments fail validation. The functions must exist in the surface's catalog.

DataPaths.description: Data binding configuration for the component.

paths.description: A dictionary mapping custom state keys to distinct JSON Pointer paths in the data model. The host pushes a `ui/notifications/data-model-update` notification whenever a bound value changes and writes authorized `ui/notifications/data-model-change` notifications back to the path.
